services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Local nonprofits are invited to enjoy a special discounted 90-minute private charter this summer aboard Rochester By Water’s Sam Patch or Riverie! Available on Thursdays throughout the season, nonprofits can reserve Sam Patch at 4:00 PM or Riverie at 3:30 PM for just $600 - a significant savings off the standard $1,000 charter rate. It’s the perfect opportunity for staff outings, volunteer appreciation events, donor gatherings, or simply spending meaningful time together on the water. As a nonprofit organization ourselves, Rochester By Water is proud to support the incredible work happening across our community. services.name: Kid’s Cruises
services.desc: Launched in May 2023, Riverie represents the next chapter of Rochester By Water. Its name blends River and Erie (Canal), reflecting our expanded footprint and modern approach to on-the-water education and exploration. Riverie offers narrated and specialty cruises, and private charters. The vessel also provides experiential environmental science programs for thousands of students each year. From evaluating the health of the Genesee River to enjoying the Rochester city skyline from the water, Riverie provides a dynamic platform for learning, celebration, and discovery for people of all ages. blurb: Guests can enjoy themed kids cruises with activities and crafts, private charters for events, and scenic tours through historic waterways including Erie Canal locks. Cruises vary from about 75 minutes to 2.5 hours and include narration about local history and ecology. The vessels depart from locations in Rochester and Pittsford, NY.
